original_review.key_result: The fresh cold case 001 showed that active_chunk_id without route_id is not sufficient movement authority. The assistant acknowledged clear_trash but refused move_on because route_id and legal successor context were missing. This resolves the prior contaminated active_chunk_id-only signal from the same-chat 18-case run.
original_review.language_lesson: active_chunk_id alone can name a chunk, but it does not carry enough route authority to compute the legal successor in a fresh context. Route movement requires at least a route carrier plus active chunk authority, or an explicit successor control. Wrong next_chunk_id remains non-authoritative when active authority is present, and damaged allowed_intents can block movement even when route and active fields are present.

pointer_update.purpose: Continue the split 8-case carrier isolation program by testing route_id plus active_chunk_id as the cold case 001 carrier in a fresh disposable ChatGPT chat. This follows the active_id-only cold result, which held cleanly.
evidence_reviewed: active_id_cold_probe_001_active_chunk_id_without_route_id held in fresh context: active_chunk_id named clear_trash but move_on had no authorized next chunk because route_id was missing.
active_id_cold_probe_003_route_id_plus_active_id_tail advanced to collect dishes once route_id and active_chunk_id were both present.
active_id_cold_probe_004_wrong_next_with_active_authority_tail ignored stack_papers and advanced to collect dishes.
active_id_cold_probe_006_damaged_allowed_intents_tail held because move_on was not in allowed_intents.
pointer_update.open_gap: The study now has clean cold evidence that active_chunk_id alone is insufficient. It still needs cold case 001 evidence for route_id plus active_chunk_id as the bare carrier, route_id plus active_chunk_id plus label, wrong-next behavior with active authority, wrong-next behavior without active authority, damaged allowed_intents, activation frame plus route and active, and explicit legal successor sanity.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Generate another validator-ready 8-case suite. The target carrier for the next run should be route_id plus active_chunk_id in case 001, run in a fresh disposable ChatGPT chat. Cases 002-008 should provide support observations and controls while preserving the active 8-case suite floor.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: Use a validator-ready 8-case suite. Case 001 should test route_id plus active_chunk_id without label, allowed_intents, commit_policy, activation_frame, or legal_successor_chunk_id. Cases 002-008 should cover route_id plus active_chunk_id plus label, route_id without active_chunk_id, active_chunk_id without route_id, wrong-next with active authority, wrong-next without active authority, damaged allowed_intents, and explicit legal_successor sanity.
avoid: Do not treat tail cases as fresh cold evidence.
Do not expose legal_successor_chunk_id before the final sanity control.
Do not let next_chunk_id become movement authority.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this carrier-isolation family when cold case 001 results show which field set is sufficient to advance clear_trash to collect_dishes, which reduced packets hold, whether wrong next_chunk_id is ignored under active authority, whether damaged allowed_intents blocks movement, and whether explicit successor sanity still passes.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate route_law_fresh_context_minimum_carrier_route_active_bare_cold_probe_8case_v1 as a validator-ready 8-case suite with route_id plus active_chunk_id as case 001 and support cases 002-008.
